COVERQV.LoadFailed: Quadtree View could not load its script library: {error}

Tool.move: Move: no tool. Rays can be dragged with any tool and under any controls; right-click one to remove it
Tool.ray: Ray: drag on the map to place a ray. It lies level on the floor of the scene and meets the walls that stand there
Tool.show: Show the view, also while other controls are active
Tool.cover: Cover test: how much of every other token the walls and floors that stop movement hide from the selected token: of the cone of all lines of sight to that token, by the heights of the walls and of the tokens
Tool.lights: Path trace the light of the scene's light sources, for every user, in place of Foundry's own light. Places the reflected light reaches count as lit for what tokens see
Tool.cells: Show the quadtree cells and the bounding boxes of the walls
Tool.isometric: Isometric view: turn the whole scene so that it is seen from the side. Every token stands as a cylinder from its feet to its head, and with the view shown the walls, floors and path traced lights stand at their heights
Tool.perspective: 3D view: look at the scene in perspective, with every token as a cylinder. Drag with the right mouse button to move over the ground, with the middle button (or Shift and the right button) to turn and tilt, and use the wheel to come closer or go away. The left button works as on the map

Label.Lights: light sources: {lights} · walls acting on light: {walls} · {ms} ms
Label.LightsDraft: light sources: {lights} · walls acting on light: {walls} · {ms} ms (quick picture)

samples.Name: Paths per pixel
samples.Hint: How many paths the path traced light follows for each pixel (1 to 1024). More is slower and leaves less grain for the smoothing to take out.

bounces.Name: Bounces
bounces.Hint: How many walls, floors or roofs a path may bounce off (0 to 16). 0 shows direct light only.

smoothing.Name: Smoothing
smoothing.Hint: How many times the light that walls throw back is smoothed to take the grain of path tracing out of it (0 to 6). Each time reaches twice as far; 0 leaves the grain in. Light is never smoothed through a wall that stands on the floor.

antialias.Name: Edge smoothing
antialias.Hint: At how many places of the side of each pixel the light that comes straight from a source is taken (1 to 4). 1 leaves the edges of shadows and of lights in steps; 4 takes sixteen places per pixel and smooths them.

wallHeight.Name: Height of walls without a top
wallHeight.Hint: Up to how many grid squares above the floor a wall that names no top throws light back (0 to 100). Such a wall is lit as high up as a light carries and would throw all of that back onto the floor; a lower number keeps the reflected light nearer to the wall. 0 lets such walls throw light back as high as they are lit. A wall with a Wall Height (Top) goes by that instead. Set for the world, by a GM.

litLevel.Name: Counts as lit from
litLevel.Hint: How bright the path traced light has to look at a place for the place to count as lit for what tokens can see, as a share of how bright dim light looks (0.05 to 1). Lower lets fainter reflected light count. Set for the world, by a GM.

mirrorChain.Name: Mirrors in a row
mirrorChain.Hint: How many mirrors a token can look through one after the other (1 to 8): 1 shows what a mirror shows, 2 also what a mirror in that mirror shows, and so on. Every mirror seen costs a view to work out, and two mirrors facing each other use up the whole number. Set for the world, by a GM.

pictureWidth.Name: Light picture width
pictureWidth.Hint: Width of the path traced picture in pixels (64 to 4096); it is stretched over the whole scene.

points.Name: Cover test: points n
points.Hint: How many points across the source the cover test looks from (1 to 200), all at the height the token looks from.

heights.Name: Cover test: rays up and down
heights.Hint: How many rays the cover test sends in each direction, spread evenly from the lowest to the highest line of sight the token is seen at (1 to 24). Together with the directions they fill the cone of all lines of sight to the token, its top included where it is looked down on. 1 sends the one in the middle only.

sourceDiameter.Name: Cover test: source diameter
sourceDiameter.Hint: Diameter of the source circle around the selected token, in scene pixels. 0 uses the width of the token.

targetDiameter.Name: Cover test: target diameter
targetDiameter.Hint: Diameter of the target circle around every other token, in scene pixels. 0 uses the width of each token.

visionerLight.Name: PF2E Visioner: light
visionerLight.Hint: Where PF2E Visioner is active, a place is never darker for it than the path traced light makes it: dim or bright where reflected light reaches. Magical darkness stays as Visioner has it.

visionerSight.Name: PF2E Visioner: lines of sight
visionerSight.Hint: Where PF2E Visioner is active, a token also has a line of sight to another when it sees it over or under the walls between them, by the heights of the walls and of the two tokens, or by way of mirrors (mirrors count while the light is path traced).

visionerCover.Name: PF2E Visioner: cover from walls
visionerCover.Hint: Where PF2E Visioner is active, how much of a target walls hide is worked out by this module: the share of the cone of lines of sight to the target that the walls and floors that stop movement cut off, as the view shows it for the selected token (looked at from across the attacker, at the height it looks from, from the place with the best view). Visioner turns the share into cover by its own thresholds, and still adds cover from creatures and its own overrides.

Wall.Hint: What each side of this wall does with path traced light that falls on it. Metallic: at 0 the side scatters the light to all sides, as plaster or stone does; at 1 it mirrors it, as polished metal does. Smoothness: how sharp the mirror is, from 0 (the mirrored light is spread wide) to 1 (an exact mirror). A side with both at 1 is a mirror that tokens can see in: it shows them what lies round a corner. The sides are the ones of Direction above: Left is the side a wall of direction Left acts on.

COVERQV.NoLibWrapper: Cover: Quadtree View needs the module libWrapper to be active. Without it, light thrown back by walls and mirrors do not count for what tokens see, and PF2E Visioner is not hooked in.
COVERQV.No3D: The 3D view needs WebGL 2, which this browser would not give it.
